items.quote: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
items.claim: The text says he (Noah, named in 8:11) waited another seven days and sent the dove out of the ark again.
items.mechanism: waited seven more days, then released the dove again

items.quote: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
items.claim: The text says the dove came back in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf, and from this Noah knew the floodwaters had gone down.
items.object: the waters were abated from off the earth
items.mechanism: the olive leaf the dove brought back showed that plants were above water again
